scope: Plain GLB structure, geometry and tier parity; kinematic contact/link tests and finite-inventory mission safety interlocks. General self-collision, flight forces and load engineering are not certified.
checks: SAI-93 exported width/length/height versus SAI-92; no sensor head/yaw in any tier; shared bay bytes unchanged
Six authoritative plain GLBs: hashes, names, finite/nondegenerate triangles, zero errors/warnings
Master/game/static root frames, sockets and bounds agree; static adapters do not articulate
Unit and service-bay game budgets; one-draw distance tiers under 250 KB
Sampled complete mission plus folding/impact sweeps: foot contact, rigid links, telescopic overlap
No takeoff thrust while anchors or mining head are deployed; drilling only while planted
Finite ore conserved through full and partial-load returns; idle waits for command
Four recall phases, all selectable field corners, pause, invalid sites and full-receiver hold
Docked ore outlet falls within 0.5 m of the receiving hopper; hoses bind named supply sockets
